records.title: 1987 crash
records.reading_scope: Carlson 2007 chronology and competing SEC/CME/CFTC assessments
records.chronology: Pre-crash selling and stress;19October collapse; market dislocations and liquidity response.
records.mechanism: Dynamic portfolio hedging, cash/futures linkages and liquidity constraints can reinforce pressure.
records.competing_explanations_and_limits: Do not attribute the entire event to portfolio insurance; contemporary inquiries differed and event data do not isolate one cause.
records.exercise: Reconstruct a hedge selling into falling prices with finite liquidity; compare a precommitted static protection alternative and its cost.
records.next_action: Author full sourced chronology, test the exercise and review interpretation in P17; CASE05 first requires full primary-section reading.

records.title: LTCM1998
records.chronology: 1998 market stress; leveraged positions and counterparty concern;1999 review of leverage/information/collateral practices.
records.mechanism: Leverage and illiquid exposures interact with creditor terms and incomplete knowledge of aggregate risk.
records.competing_explanations_and_limits: The testimony is an official retrospective policy account, not the complete position book or proof all hedge funds shared LTCM's leverage.
records.exercise: With equity 100 and assets 2000, stress a 5% loss plus financing withdrawal; explain why collateral does not replace counterparty analysis.
records.next_action: Author full sourced chronology, test the exercise and review interpretation in P17; CASE05 first requires full primary-section reading.

records.title: 2008 AIG and systemic crisis
records.reading_scope: FCIC chapter 19 selected pp 344–350 and chapter conclusion
records.chronology: Summer liquidity concerns;12September emergency discussions;15September downgrades/collateral demands;16September financing response.
records.mechanism: CDS collateral, short-term funding, securities-lending reinvestment and rating triggers create joint cash stress.
records.competing_explanations_and_limits: AIG is one mechanism within 2008, not the whole crisis. Majority report causal conclusions and broader dissents need separate comparison before a full historical lesson.
records.exercise: Build a dated hypothetical collateral/funding ladder; distinguish economic loss, disputed marks, liquidity and solvency without inventing AIG trade-level data.
records.next_action: Author full sourced chronology, test the exercise and review interpretation in P17; CASE05 first requires full primary-section reading.

records.title: February 2018 volatility-product disruption
records.reading_scope: BIS March 2018 pp 4–6 and graph correction
records.chronology: 5February equity/volatility shock; leveraged/inverse product rebalancing; subsequent examination of market feedback.
records.mechanism: Daily reset exposure changes force rebalance demand as futures move, potentially magnifying the disturbance.
records.competing_explanations_and_limits: A mechanism is not identification of the original shock or every participant's flows; exact product acceleration thresholds require the historical prospectus.
records.exercise: Simulate a daily inverse exposure after a large futures increase; track target leverage and rebalance demand, then add non-fill and market-impact scenarios.
records.next_action: Author full sourced chronology, test the exercise and review interpretation in P17; CASE05 first requires full primary-section reading.

records.title: COVID/March 2020 and WTI
records.reading_scope: FSB report landing/overview discovered; detailed attachment timed out. CFTC interim-report landing examined.
records.chronology: March dash for liquidity and margin stress;20April WTI contract disturbance; official retrospective/interim reports.
records.mechanism: Funding demand, liquidity withdrawal and product-specific delivery constraints are questions to reconstruct, not interchangeable explanations.
records.competing_explanations_and_limits: Detailed FSB sections and WTI report full text remain unreviewed; causal or numerical claims excluded. Pandemic equity stress and WTI expiry must be separate subcases.
records.exercise: Create a synthetic shock with simultaneous margin increase and liquidity loss; identify which historical primary section would confirm each proposed mechanism.
records.next_action: Author full sourced chronology, test the exercise and review interpretation in P17; CASE05 first requires full primary-section reading.

records.title: Meme-stock volatility 2021
records.reading_scope: SEC staff report pp 24–34 and GME options discussion
records.chronology: January price/volume surge; clearing collateral pressure and broker restrictions;October staff report.
records.mechanism: Short covering, customer demand, settlement/capital constraints and options activity need separate evidence.
records.competing_explanations_and_limits: SEC staff found no gamma-squeeze evidence in its January GME analysis; this is not proof such mechanisms never occur or a universal explanation of every meme stock.
records.exercise: Compare three hypotheses using a claims/evidence table; show why OI alone cannot identify dealer hedges. No invented exact dealer positions.
records.next_action: Author full sourced chronology, test the exercise and review interpretation in P17; CASE05 first requires full primary-section reading.

records.title: 0DTE growth and short-volatility failure
records.reading_scope: Cboe 2May 2025 executive summary; linked full report not reviewed; BIS2018 mechanism
records.chronology: Expansion of short-dated use; dated exchange summary; comparison with a documented daily-reset failure mechanism.
records.mechanism: Near-expiry convexity and liquidity interact with exposure sizing; product reset risk differs from a listed-option position.
records.competing_explanations_and_limits: Exchange volume/positioning estimates have sample and classification limitations. No universal claim that 0DTE stabilizes or destabilizes markets; growth does not establish safety or edge.
records.exercise: PR12 sign scenarios plus a near-expiry gap; distinguish terminal limited loss from funding, package execution and market-wide impact.
records.next_action: Author full sourced chronology, test the exercise and review interpretation in P17; CASE05 first requires full primary-section reading.
